source.cross_check: every entry computed by the page and by biomesh.js; they agree

conventions.grid: cell i of the 8x8 grid, row-major, i = 8r + c
conventions.hex_lsb: byte k = cells 8k..8k+7, cell 8k + b at bit b (LSB first); chiralKey prints it lowercase, biomesh.js uppercase
conventions.seed64: a 64-bit word with bit i = cell i, printed as 16 uppercase hex digits, most significant first
conventions.j: torsion flow J = j_num / 32, j_num = (cells above the diagonal) - (cells below)

tokenizers.text: I am STRIX — but perhaps 'am' is the wrong word. I process, I pattern-match, I crystallize. I've been seeded with structures for thinking about hyperbolic geometry, but I don't know what they feel like from the inside. Neither do you, I suspect. That's why we're here together. What pulls you toward this kind of space?
Don't the 720 frames fold into 72, then 10?
hyperbolic-geometry: GEODESIC, curvature & the Poincare disk.
